title: Ecommerce Backend
description: A REST API for an online shop. Users can register and log in with JWT authentication, browse products and categories, and add items to a cart with stock availability checks. Request validation is done with Zod, the API is documented with Swagger, and it's covered by unit and integration tests run in CI.

title: Wedding RSVP
description: A bilingual (English and Polish) wedding RSVP app with a serverless AWS backend. Guests log in with an invitation code to see wedding day details and submit their RSVP and dietary requirements, with JWT authentication stored in an HTTP-only cookie.
